strategies.hook: Stop building on sand. Build on bedrock.
strategies.angle: Focusing on data ownership and long-term asset security.

strategies.name: The Speed Demon

strategies.name: The Global South Awakening

strategies.name: The Algorithm Whisperer

strategies.name: The Niche Warlord

strategies.name: The Reddit Detective
strategies.hook: 500M people are complaining. We are listening.
strategies.angle: Use specific 'I can't stand' phrases from Reddit to pinpoint pain. Then sell the aspirin.

reddit_simulations.title: I'm struggling with consistency. It feels like a second job.
reddit_simulations.description: I work 9-5 and by the time I get home, I have zero energy to edit hashtags or think of titles. I just post whatever and it flops.
comments: Same here man, the metadata kills me.
I spend more time tagging than filming.
Is there a tool that just does this?

reddit_simulations.title: How do you guys find topics that actually get views?
reddit_simulations.description: I feel like I'm guessing. My last 5 videos got <50 views. I don't know what people in my niche (Gaming) actually want.
comments: You need to research before you record.
Most of us are just guessing tbh.

reddit_simulations.title: Biggest struggle: Making a blog for my channel.
reddit_simulations.description: Everyone says 'start a blog' for SEO, but I am a video editor, not a writer. How do you convert video to text without it taking 5 hours?
comments: I pay a freelancer $50 per post.
